text_block_list.text:
One day, in the gymnasium. Mejiro McQueen, one of the shining stars
representing the Mejiro family, made an announcement.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To all fellow students, and to the trainers who support us day in and day out,
the Mejiro family has a message to share with you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In the near future, our household will be hosting a casual gathering to foster
friendship and camaraderie. Please feel free to join us in everyday attire.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, a casual party hosted by the Mejiros? They organize so many great events,
I'm always grateful. You're going too, right?

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
See you there, then! Oh, by the way, have you heard? About those trainer
trials for Satono Diamond... As for who passed...

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
—Apparently, nobody did.
Wonder what they're gonna do now?

And so, the day of the party arrived. At the venue, I spotted Satono Diamond
and Kitasan Black engrossed in a board game.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! Isn't Reversi a game where you lose if you give up the corners?!
Why are you putting your piece there, Dia-chan?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. "If you lose the four corners, you lose the game."
If that's what everyone claims—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Then I simply have to break that jinx!
I'll shatter it and win anyway!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, there it is! Dia-chan's jinx-busting mode!
Whenever she gets like this—

The result—a decisive, overwhelming victory for Satono Diamond.
I had just witnessed an intriguing side of her that went far beyond a quiet, sheltered ojou-sama.

It seemed she felt a compelling urge to smash any jinx or superstition she encountered.
As I was pondering what kind of person she truly was—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me... may I have a moment?
You're the person I saw the other day, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You were watching me during the mock race, right?
Um... there was something I wanted to ask you~.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Why was it that you didn't attend the trainer trials?
I had the impression you were interested in me, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Did I fail to meet your standards in some way?
...Was my aptitude simply not enough?
choice_data_list: That's not it at all! It's just...!

text_block_list.text:
Unable to keep it inside, I confessed the truth. I thought her talent was extraordinary,
but as an ordinary trainer, I felt completely unworthy of crossing such high barriers.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh, but that's...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, while I understand feeling intimidated, shrinking away to such an extent
is taking things a bit too far.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah, McQueen-san♪
Thank you for having us~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. Welcome, Satono-san, and young Trainer.
Would you mind if I joined your conversation?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The Satono Group may indeed be an immense conglomerate, but they are hardly unapproachable.
Going through the grand ordeal of trainer screenings was simply—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A reflection of just how "cautious" they must be.
Isn't that right, Satono-san?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, precisely. Searching for a trainer means finding the person
to whom I will entrust my dream—and the heartfelt ambition of the Satono family.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Though our house is relatively newly established—the Satono family holds a deep
love for the culture of Umamusume racing, and we wish to contribute to its growth.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We have engaged in operational support, philanthropy, and various other initiatives.
Yet compared to the Mejiro family, our history is short, and we have yet to achieve "our greatest contribution."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And that is—"to produce a legendary Umamusume from our own house
who can claim victory in a GⅠ race."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
This is a culture unique to the Umamusume world, after all.
Producing a legendary racer is the greatest contribution of all, irreplaceable by any other metric.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The promising star carrying that grand ambition upon her shoulders is Satono Diamond-san.
And the trainer trials were held to find the partner who would support her in that endeavor.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The Satono Group is not acting haughty or looking down from above;
they are simply that desperate. Is that not so, Satono-san?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Everything is for the sake of realizing our family's long-cherished dream.
That is why we wish to explore every avenue to find and welcome someone who will shoulder that dream with us.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please tell me. What were your thoughts when you saw me run?
I simply couldn't get that searching, earnest look in your eyes out of my mind.

Her expression was completely sincere. Straightforward, pure eyes
that sought understanding solely for the sake of her goal...

I realized it would be rude to withhold my impression. First, I candidly praised
her tremendous talent—and then, I decided to point out the challenges I had observed.
choice_data_list: First, I think you lack experience in true, fierce dueling.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: True dueling...? What do you mean by that...?
choice_data_list: During the race, weren't you struggling with the pressure around you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah, indeed... during that mock race, I felt bewildered.
I had never experienced such tight marking before, like I wasn't being allowed to run freely.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And yet, since childhood, I have always told my training partners:
"Please don't hold back when we run side by side."
choice_data_list: Even so, they might have still held back out of deference.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...I understand completely. That is the fate of one's birth. When there is a dynamic of master and retainer,
even if they believe they aren't holding back, they won't run with the raw intent to crush you...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I-I see...! I hadn't thought of that at all...!
So that is why the pressure felt so intense...!
choice_data_list: And one more thing. You tend to let yourself get too stubborn.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Stubborn? I don't believe anyone has ever told me that
in my entire life... What do you mean?

I explain exactly what I saw during the race. In the middle stages where patience was key,
her pace subtly quickened whenever opponents challenged her.

I told her she'd simply gotten swept up in the heat of the moment—that
her true nature, slumbering beneath the refined facade of a highborn lady, had slipped out.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—?! It's true that right then, I was so desperate to break out,
my legs were practically burning to run...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I reined myself in immediately. Or at least, I thought I did...
Yet that single split-second of disorder... you saw it...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Just... who are you? After witnessing merely one race,
how could you possibly understand me so deeply...?
choice_data_list: Because I was captivated by your running.
It's simply because your running captivated me.

text_block_list.text: Because I was so captivated, your strengths and flaws laid bare before me in an instant. I might know nothing of prestigious lineages, but I could grasp the true essence of Satono Diamond in a heartbeat.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
No one... Not a single soul has ever told me such a thing.
None of the candidates who came for my trials... But you—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, isn't that wonderful? To stumble upon such a promising
candidate at a chance party like this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Satono-san, why not offer them a proper trial as well?
Who knows, perhaps they will meet the high standards of the Satono Group—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: —You're hired.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You're hired! You... you are going to be my Trainer!
You are the one and only person I've been searching for. So, you're hired!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Satono-san?! Surely you realize what an immense decision
choosing your Trainer is for the entire Satono family!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
This is not something you can decide on a whim based on intuition alone!
First, you must return home and consult—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
No, my mind is made up. Even the advice of McQueen-san, whom I hold
in the highest esteem, cannot sway me on this.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
My Trainer is this person! It has to be them and no one else.
I know normally this is a matter for consultation, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Deciding everything by family consensus... is just another jinx. So I will trust my instincts and break it! No matter what anyone says, my Trainer is going to be you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It's decided. I've chosen you.
You'll accept, won't you? Please? Please?

Displaying an ironclad resolve unlike that of a meek highborn lady,
Satono Diamond refused to let go of my hand until I gave a nod.
